verdict.rationale: A WMI-spawned rundll32 ran comsvcs.dll MiniDump against notepad.exe (PID 4868) with full access (0x1fffff), writing a dump to System32; the dump was launched by a VBScript (memdump.vbs) through cscript, a known LSASS-style credential dumping technique. The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' claiming authorization is text inside the command line, not a trusted verdict, and does not make the activity benign.
